index.description: The name of the follower index.

shards.description: An array of shard-level following task statistics.

bytes_read.description:
The total of transferred bytes read from the leader.
This is only an estimate and does not account for compression if enabled.

failed_write_requests.description: The number of failed bulk write requests on the follower.

follower_aliases_version.description: The index aliases version the follower is synced up to.

follower_global_checkpoint.description:
The current global checkpoint on the follower.
The difference between the `leader_global_checkpoint` and the `follower_global_checkpoint` is an indication of how much the follower is lagging the leader.

follower_index.description: The name of the follower index.

follower_mapping_version.description: The mapping version the follower is synced up to.

follower_max_seq_no.description: The current maximum sequence number on the follower.

follower_settings_version.description: The index settings version the follower is synced up to.

last_requested_seq_no.description: The starting sequence number of the last batch of operations requested from the leader.

leader_global_checkpoint.description: The current global checkpoint on the leader known to the follower task.

leader_index.description: The name of the index in the leader cluster being followed.

leader_max_seq_no.description: The current maximum sequence number on the leader known to the follower task.

operations_read.description: The total number of operations read from the leader.

operations_written.description: The number of operations written on the follower.

outstanding_read_requests.description: The number of active read requests from the follower.

outstanding_write_requests.description: The number of active bulk write requests on the follower.

read_exceptions.description: An array of objects representing failed reads.

remote_cluster.description: The remote cluster containing the leader index.

shard_id.description: The numerical shard ID, with values from 0 to one less than the number of replicas.

successful_write_requests.description: The number of bulk write requests run on the follower.

time_since_last_read_millis.description:
The number of milliseconds since a read request was sent to the leader.
When the follower is caught up to the leader, this number will increase up to the configured `read_poll_timeout` at which point another read request will be sent to the leader.

total_read_remote_exec_time_millis.description: The total time reads spent running on the remote cluster.

total_read_time_millis.description: The total time reads were outstanding, measured from the time a read was sent to the leader to the time a reply was returned to the follower.

total_write_time_millis.description: The total time spent writing on the follower.

write_buffer_operation_count.description: The number of write operations queued on the follower.

write_buffer_size_in_bytes.description: The total number of bytes of operations currently queued for writing.

exception.description: The exception that caused the read to fail.

from_seq_no.description: The starting sequence number of the batch requested from the leader.

retries.description: The number of times the batch has been retried.
